title: The Multiverse menu
text: The Multiverse status key opens one menu with tabs: Status (soul, EP, mana, Djinn, grimoire need), Weapons, Relics, Bestiary, Spirit Lords, Beast Will, Rules and this Wiki. Turn pages with A and D or the tabs. GUI Move and GUI Size let you drag and resize every panel. Keep your screen clean: the menu replaces most pop-up windows.
